prompt_set.key_visual:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: art direction key image for a new native Game Boy Color platformer, later translated to genuine tiny pixel assets.
Primary request: an extraordinary original 1990s handheld platformer key visual called MOONWAKE. An adorable cream moon hare called Kip, very long expressive ears, a flowing persimmon-red comet scarf, running across a luminous rooftop pagoda over a sky sea at peach sunset. Tiny celadon floating lanterns and origami seabirds drift across the indigo sea. A monumental celestial whale silhouette sleeps under a huge pearl moon at the horizon. Dreamlike playful optimism, stunning restrained graphic composition, enchanting original world.
Style/medium: premium hand placed pixel art, exact pixel clusters, no outlines around individual pixels, no blur, 1990s Japanese adventure box art translated into sophisticated contemporary pixel design. Not vector. Wide pixel art composition with large shapes that remain readable on a 160x144 screen, irregular organic silhouettes and tiny intentional highlights.
Color palette: deep aubergine/indigo, cream pearl, dusty peach, persimmon scarlet, celadon jade, pale cyan. Beautiful controlled contrast.
Composition/framing: square key visual, prominent readable large hare lower center, enormous graphic moon and sweeping whale upper background, expressive scarf leading the eye. Title typography "MOONWAKE" centered at top with a poetic moon motif in O. No secondary text.
Constraints: original design, no copyrighted commercial game characters, no console/product mockup, no screenshot frame, no watermarks.
